title: RecallResult
description: Output contract for crystalium.recall(). Slot breakdown mirrors the Baddeley working-set model (MISSION.md §Bounded, slotted working set).

records.description: Array of crystal summaries returned by the Aetheryte, after redaction.

content_ref.description: Blob-tier SHA-256 ref for episodic crystals. Callers resolve separately.

score.description: Retrieval relevance score from the Aetheryte hybrid retrieval.

slot_breakdown.description: Per-slot token counts used by the working-set composer (FORGE D9, G6).

total_tokens.description: Total tokens in the assembled working set (must be <= 3500, MISSION.md §Bounded).

evicted_count.description: Number of candidates evicted to satisfy the token budget (token-budget drops ONLY — never includes candidates dropped by the k gate; see budget.truncated_count).

budget.description: Working-set budget (crystalium#36, v1.9.0). ALWAYS present, in every recall_relevance_primary mode — an explain-only budget would recreate the discoverability failure issue #36 is about.

total_cap.description: Fixed hard token cap for the assembled working set (currently 3500; never scales with k).

slots.description: Per-slot token caps (mirrors Config.slots: executive, procedural, semantic, episodic, execution, buffer).

k_applied.description: Number of records actually returned in this response.

truncated_count.description: Candidates dropped by the k gate only (never folded with evicted_count, which stays token-budget-only).

explain.description: v1.6+ diagnostic object, populated only when the caller opts in (explain=true). Diagnostic/unstable — additionalProperties is intentionally loose so evolving keys (e.g. k_applied, truncated_by_k) never re-drift this schema. See aetheryte/retrieve.py::recall() docstring for the current shape.
